text: {"lessons":["A sale at a gain or loss is not proof the decision was good; judge trades by their rationale and what I learn, not by my average cost alone.","Several holdings and trades can still leave me exposed to losses; keep position sizes and cash reserves consistent with the risk I can bear.","Short-term account swings are noisy. Make deliberate, evidence-based decisions rather than reacting to one month’s return or a recent price move."]}
